notes: Background: mid-market product analytics platform serving 1k+ merchants. Heavy embedding use for search + short summarization for ticket triage.
Current stack: using OpenAI (embeddings + gpt-4 style chat) for production. Wants to reduce cost and avoid single-vendor outage dependency.
Why Redwood: interested in unified hosted -> dedicated path, transparent perf profiles, per-token cost analytics. Likes builtin routing/fallback idea.
POC approach: 2-week hosted POC using compat shim that translates OpenAI params to Redwood models and provides a mapping table for temperature/stop/sequences.
Technical ask: maintain prompt parity for 95%+ of existing production prompts; regressions must be explainable (tokenization, model variant, decoding differences).

Observed during POC: embeddings cosine similarities comparable, but summarization outputs differ on edge cases (long bullet-lists). SE believes issue may be prompt-tokenization + prompt-engineering gap.
Quote from product lead: 'If summaries shift even slightly it affects downstream ML signals — we need an A/B run and regression gating before switching.'
Security: requires SSO (SAML), SOC2 attestation, audit logs for API keys, and optional EU residency for PII-enriched metadata.
Deployment preference: start on Hosted (fast time-to-value), then transition to Dedicated for consistent tail latency and reserved throughput once parity validated.
Cost sensitivity: medium-high. Open to a 12-mo reserved contract for Dedicated if unit economics are >=20% improvement vs current vendor.
Operational: wants token-level cost dashboard and per-route tracing to attribute regressions to model/version changes.
Open items: finance needs committed pricing scenarios, security needs KMS paperwork, product wants a canary strategy that supports rollback to old provider on regressions.
Next actions for team: run full prompt-parity harness (50k tokens), produce regression report, map model variants to fallback policies, schedule dedicated sizing call.
